verdict.rationale: Simular can save a workflow as replayable code or as a named, parameterized skill, and its saved code self-heals when the UI changes. But the evidence never documents versioning, change history, diff or review of automations, or rolling back to a prior version. Saved-as-code scripts could be tracked in a user's own source control, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
